kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate
wire.summary: As the fast-moving outbreak continues to spread in eastern Congo, fighting between rebels and the army is disrupting efforts to contain the spread of the disease.

wire.title: North Korea's Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump's overture
wire.summary: Leader Kim Jong Un reportedly visited facilities that produce nuclear ingredients and called for building more nuclear weapons to cope with threats from the U.S. and South Korea.

wire.title: Storms disrupt Thanksgiving travel. And, FCC violated ABC's free speech, judge says
wire.summary: The East Coast's weather is a major concern this holiday, as it could lead to coastal flooding. And, the judge says the FCC can't punish ABC for satire Trump doesn't like.

wire.title: At Albuquerque's Indian Pueblo Kitchen, Native American dishes are the main course
wire.summary: At an Albuquerque, N.M., museum, the restaurant is just as much of a draw as the exhibitions, with dishes like green chile stew and sweet biscochitos flavored with anise and cinnamon.

wire.title: 'Memories of a Good Meal': How food made a difference during WWII
wire.summary: New Orleans Chef Alon Shaya's new cookbook shares stories of resilience from World War II, centered around food.

wire.title: A dish with a story, Thanksgiving with culinary historian Michael Twitty
wire.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel welcomes culinary historian Michael Twitty into her kitchen for a Thanksgiving cooking session on making Kush, the forerunner to Southern cornbread dressing.

wire.title: Court lets Puerto Rico governor fire firm that runs the island's troubled power grid
wire.summary: LUMA Energy took over the electric grid five years ago. The court's ruling nullifies its contract, and gives the government a year to find a new operator.

wire.title: Powerful storms disrupt holiday travel, as Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed
wire.summary: Extreme weather that has unleashed strong winds, high tides, heavy rain and floods is expected to impact travel plans of an estimated 81.5 million people as they travel across the United States.

wire.title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
wire.summary: The Trump administration gave Elon Musk's SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a move that has raised skepticism among scientists.

wire.title: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dies at 65
wire.summary: Taylor revealed his battle with Stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer in 2022. He was the guitarist of the 1980s English band Duran Duran, whose pop hits included "Hungry Like the Wolf" and "Rio".

wire.title: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US
wire.summary: Hundreds of thousands have been affected by storms in the country as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend begins.

wire.title: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds
wire.summary: Nearly a third of crossings in early 2026 allegedly involved boats or engines from the German man's firm.

wire.title: Watch: BBC confronts German man suspected of supplying migrant gangs with small boats
wire.summary: Marvin Reuter is contesting extradition to France, where he could face smuggling, criminal conspiracy and involuntary manslaughter charges.

wire.title: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one
wire.summary: The possible environmental damage is still being assessed by Spain's sea rescue service.

wire.title: Gérard Depardieu to stand trial for alleged rape of actress in 2018, court rules
wire.summary: A Paris appeals court rules Depardieu will go on trial for the alleged rape of Charlotte Arnould.

wire.title: Pregnant US inmate escapes in prison vehicle after medical appointment
wire.summary: Rebecca Taylor had been imprisoned in New Mexico for multiple theft and burglary charges.
